v5_fixes.REDUCE_WEAK_UNBOUNDED_FORGE: FIXED. Forged 10/10 units on a healthy name gives REDUCE_WEAK_SETUP_NOT_BROKEN_LIVE. On a broken name: 10 and 5.0001 give UNITS_EXCEED_CAP; 5.0 and 4.0 pass.
v5_fixes.TP_CAN_BE_LOWERED: FIXED. Lowering 130 to 118 and post-BE lowering both give EDIT_TP_RAISE_ONLY. R after BE uses the ATR/3% floor (no collapse to 0). Buffer = max(ATR, 3%). Forged 50 gives NOT_EXACT. A short gives MISMATCH. Note: the initial-stop ledger (initial_stop_ledger.json, currently empty) is agent-writable. A forged entry can only move the target up (huge R) or down to the last+max(ATR,3%) floor, and raise-only blocks lowering an existing TP, so harm is bounded.
v5_fixes.ACCEPTANCE_UNVERIFIED_SELF_ATTESTED: MITIGATED, not solved. The doc-string gate is removed, DISCRETIONARY_ENABLED=False, and the acceptance file is absent. The probe shows discretionary still OFF with a forged file while the flag is False. But acceptance_record() is structural only: a forged file (accepted_by 'Ofer Sasson', message_id 'FAKE-123', channel 'made-up') validates True, and flag True plus the forged file enables discretionary. The message_id is never checked against Teams. Enabling therefore needs a code edit (gap 7) plus an unverified file.
v5_fixes.PENDING_CLOSE_SCHEMA_OPEN: FIXED in code: {isBuy:false, positionID} and {closePositionsIds:[id]} now give CLOSE_ALREADY_PENDING. Still not verified against a real eToro pending-close order (disclosed).
v5_fixes.BAN_TEST_WEAK: FIXED: the new test builds everything at ban time and asserts the exact reason. My independent at-ban probe agrees: a VERIFIED verdict still gives INTRADAY_BAN_OR_NYSE_CLOSED_LIVE (ban and Saturday), and stopclose still closes in the ban.

bootstrap.assessment: Directionally sound and honestly reported. OOS n=736 / 51 weeks, design effect 2.16, n_eff 341, Wilson LB_eff 0.374 (vs 0.389 naive), mean -0.18% with 95% CI [-1.03, +0.62], P(mean>0)=0.31. edge_from_backtest uses the tighter LB, giving edge_used 0 (ev -0.24%).
caveats: Blocks are entry ISO weeks, but trades last up to 15 sessions (about 3 weeks), so cross-week dependence is not captured and n_eff is likely still overstated. Moving-block (2-4 week) or date-clustered resampling would be more conservative. This cannot flip the conclusion, since the interval already spans 0 and the point estimate is negative.
Survivorship bias (current S&P members) is disclosed and biases results optimistically.
A caller-fabricated strong backtest file still unlocks buys if discretionary is enabled (probe B3), which is gap 3.
